messages:
sara_mkt: Quick sync — finished the interview with Kitewell. They gave a short line we could slot into the case header: "Redwood reduced our inference costs while keeping performance consistent." Need legal + comms ok and to decide lead routing (we want mid-market SDRs prioritized).

ben_p: Thanks. Can you paste the verbatim quote and attach the clip? I'll make a 20s promo and a longer webinar teaser.

sara_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood reduced our inference costs while keeping performance consistent across peak loads." Audio uploaded to Files, transcript attached.

laura_legal: Recommend avoiding absolutes. Suggest edit to: "significantly reduced per-inference costs while maintaining stable performance during peak traffic." Also need the signed advocacy release on record and comms approval for the edited quote.

amy_cs: They signed the standard advocacy release and their comms lead is on standby. I'll ask PR to confirm the softened wording and provide exact attribution (name + title) for the post. Also they prefer the blog to link to their public benchmark repo.

tom_se: For routing: I'll create an SFDC campaign and map HubSpot form fields. Want to route high-intent registrants (use_case includes "benchmarking") to our mid-market SDR queue. Any tracking params we need?

ben_p: Add utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, and a boolean field 'high_intent' set server-side if use_case contains benchmark keywords. Also capture company_size. We'll want to push high intent into the SDR queue via automation.

laura_legal: Once comms confirms the exact attribution line and the release is attached, legal can sign off. No embargo noted. Please attach release file to the CMS entry before publish.

amy_cs: PR confirmed the softened wording and gave attribution: "Jordan Lee, VP Platform, Kitewell". They've approved the audio clip for a 30s teaser and asked us not to include competitor names. Release uploaded to Box (box.com/redwood/kitewell-release.pdf).

tom_se: SFDC campaign created: Kitewell_Case_Q4_24 (ID SF-9023). HubSpot form up at https://info.redwood.ai/kitewell-case. Webhook to enrichment service configured. Routing rule: if high_intent=Y then assign to queue: SDR-MID-MKT, else to inbound-nurture.

ben_p: Great. I'll draft the post and two headline variants for A/B. Sara, can you review final landing microcopy and confirm CTA?

sara_mkt: Will review. CTA options: "Read the case + register" or "See the benchmark + join webinar". Leaning to the second to attract bench-focused leads. Marking this thread for follow-up when landing is live.

laura_legal: Legal sign-off pending attachment check — once Box link and release are attached in CMS, we're clear.

amy_cs: Done — release attached and comms approval noted. No embargo.

ben_p: OK to move to publish checklist. Thanks team :rocket:
